definitions.explanation: Official relations between countries at the government level. Commonly appears in news about international politics.

examples.japanese: {国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries severed diplomatic relations.

examples.japanese: {国交|こっこう}⟦{正常化|せいじょうか}→正常化：20541_seijouka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}→記念式典：18003_kinenshikiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A commemorative ceremony was held to mark fifty years since the normalization of diplomatic relations.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term primarily used in news and political contexts. Key set phrases include {国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧ (to establish relations), {国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sever relations), and {国交|こっこう}⟦{正常化|せいじょうか}→正常化：20541_seijouka⟧ (normalization of relations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to establish diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sever diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}⟦{正常化|せいじょうか}→正常化：20541_seijouka⟧: normalization of diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: restoration of diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no diplomatic relations
